surfaces: PDB, DWARF, stripped symbols, and separate debug files
static libraries, object files, firmware blobs, and packed archives
common_failure_modes: shipped artifact differs from reviewed source
dangerous imports, exports, or syscall surfaces are missed
embedded endpoints, credentials, paths, feature flags, or protocol strings are missed
debug symbols or build paths leak sensitive implementation details
packed, stripped, or obfuscated binaries cause false confidence
native dependency or vulnerable component evidence is missed by source-only SBOMs
binary similarity hints are treated as proof instead of clustering evidence
decompiler output is over-trusted without source or independent corroboration
required_evidence_hints: file format, architecture, compiler/runtime hints, and import/export tables
strings, FLOSS output, YARA matches, DIE classification, capa output, and RetDec fileinfo when available
SBOM/CVE binary-package evidence from Syft, Grype, or Trivy when available
function, symbol, debug, CFG, decompiler, or Ghidra/angr/cwe_checker evidence when explicitly run
tool failure logs and unsupported-format notes
